title: Upgrade to v4.0.4 (Ledger/Amino signing of CosmWasm txs, claim, governance and node-operation fixes)
summary: Consensus-breaking maintenance release on top of v4.0.3 (Cosmos SDK v0.50.13). (1) Ledger, Keplr/Leap Amino and CosmJS Amino-signed CosmWasm transactions are accepted again: backport of CosmWasm/wasmd#1844 and #1860 (wasmd v0.51) onto wasmd v0.50.0; since v4.0.0 every Amino-signed MsgExecuteContract/MsgInstantiateContract/MsgMigrateContract failed with 'signature verification failed'. (2) CosmWasm VM back to wasmvm v1.5.7 (v4.0.0-v4.0.3 linked v1.5.0, dropping the 1.5.1-1.5.7 security fixes). (3) x/gov legacy proposal router restored (text and x/params ParameterChangeProposal; x/claim params can be changed by governance again). (4) x/claim: MsgClaim carries the SDK v0.50 signer annotation; the expired airdrop is disabled instead of being ended again on every block; the claim module account gets a unique account number (it shared account number 0 with another account since SDK v0.45; the upgrade handler repairs it). (5) The blocked community-pool multisig can no longer bypass its restriction by adding a MsgFundCommunityPool to the transaction. (6) Node operations: export --for-zero-height, rollback and historical queries of empty stores work again; minimum gas price floor of 12.5upasg restored. No store additions or module consensus-version changes. Every validator must switch binaries at the upgrade height. Upgrade name: v4.0.4. Binaries and checksums in the v4.0.4 release.
